capabilities: Renders notes as a 3D black-hole scene with particle disk and link paths
Opens, renames and previews notes from the arc of names
Finds the shortest chain of links between two notes
Builds lists by tag, folder, links, recency, orphans or staleness
Adjusts brightness, quality, idle pause and decorative effects
extras: Interface labels are in Brazilian Portuguese; desktop only, weak GPUs may need low quality; runs fully locally with no network requests; settings stored in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph is a flat 2D view, so there is no immersive spatial overview of notes, links and vault activity.

relations.evidence: The 3D scene uses three.js, MIT licensed.

summary: Renders the vault as a 3D black hole: golden particle disk, notes as lights on an arc, glowing lines between linked notes.
